title: A mega footer holds the full site index, every legal link and the calls to action, and publishes where its top edge is for the bottom docks
detail: Owner 2026-10-19 (item 2): the member footer was one line. FqMegaFooter (components/frequency/shared/mega-footer.tsx) is a bar that is always visible (brand, Help, Settings, a Site index toggle), a native details panel with the whole index in columns plus the calls to action, and a legal row that stays visible with the index shut (Privacy, Terms, Guidelines, Space email policy, Accessibility, Contact). The columns are the registry's footer columns, gate-filtered by lib/nav/footer-access.ts (the member site map shares that gate), and the legal set is one list, lib/nav/legal-links.ts, read by the registry, the public footer, the mega footer, llms.txt and the site map. The public footer gains Around you and Marketplace columns, a Contact link and SiteNavigationElement JSON-LD written from the columns it draws. llms.txt gains Marketplace and Legal sections. MegaFooterLift publishes --fq-foot-lift on html: 0 closed, the footer's rise above the window bottom when open (capped at 55% of the window); the docks (LIVE-1011) read it as bottom: var(--fq-foot-lift, 0px). Nothing here moves a dock. Honest gaps: the public footer keeps its dark designed panel and is not collapsible; no Download link because the repo has no app download page. LIVE-1113 (2026-10-20, ADR-1861): the owner found the bar's loose links and the unrolling panel weak, so the index now opens as a centred pop-up and the footer is one quiet row; the dock lift is no longer published (the docks read 0, the closed value).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const f=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/shared/mega-footer.tsx','utf8');const m=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/members-shell.tsx','utf8');const r=fs.readFileSync('lib/nav/registry.ts','utf8');if(!/title: 'Legal'[\s\S]{0,200}LEGAL_LINKS/.test(r))bad.push('the footer Legal column does not read the shared legal list');if(!f.includes('siteNavigationSchema'))bad.push('footer does not write its index as JSON-LD');if(!m.includes('<FqMegaFooter'))bad.push('member shell does not draw the mega footer');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1030: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the member shell goes back to a one-line footer, the footer Legal column stops reading the shared list, or the index stops writing its JSON-LD. The inline panel and its dock lift were retired by LIVE-1113 (ADR-1861); behavior is mega-footer.test.tsx.
